description: This PHP file is a controller class for the 'Online' dashboard extension in the OpenCart admin panel. It handles the display of online customer statistics, configuration settings, and saving those settings.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'Online' dashboard widget, including rendering view, saving settings, and providing online user data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the dashboard extension configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs, configuration parameters, and loading necessary views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the online dashboard extension, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Provides data about current online users in a formatted way for the dashboard view.
